entries.title: Life is Feudal: Forest Village
entries.definitive_edition: Life is Feudal: Forest Village on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Life is Feudal: Forest Village is documented on Steam as a Windows city-builder with survival aspects, Workshop support, and a May 26, 2017 release. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass. The Windows PC Steam build is the archive route, with Workshop/mod support as an optional preservation note rather than separate official content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release. Keep mods separate from the baseline archive capture unless documenting a specific Workshop scenario.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Workshop support and the only sourced platform route.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; do not conflate this standalone city-builder with the separate Life is Feudal MMO/Your Own releases.
